title: ReviewReceiptV1
description: Extended independent-review receipt bound to the reviewed tree and frozen intent (#1518). Additive over the basic receipt (reviewer nodeId, kind=review, verdict, note): when a lineage opts in, headSha/diffHash/intentHash mismatches fail closed. authorWorkerId echoes the dispatcher-declared trusted author (#1548) for audit. See docs/specs/bounded-pr-review-lifecycle/spec.md.

reviewerNodeId.description: Reviewer identity; must differ from the trusted author identity.

headSha.description: Exact reviewed head; recorded for audit. Freshness is judged on diffHash + intentHash.

diffHash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical patch bytes (git diff --no-color --no-ext-diff --no-renames --unified=3 baseSha headSha). Metadata-only commit changes leave diffHash unchanged.

intentHash.description: Must equal the frozen IntentContractV1 intentHash; mismatch fails closed.

findingLedgerRef.description: ledgerId of the FindingLedgerV1 the findings were recorded against.

authorWorkerId.description: Optional echo of the dispatcher-declared trusted author identity (#1548).
